poissonexact: Exact Conditional Inference for Poisson Regression

Source: R/poissonexact-package.R
poissonexact-package.Rd

Compute exact conditional maximum likelihood estimates, exact p-values, and exact confidence intervals for categorical effects in Poisson regression models with an optional offset and stratification. Nuisance parameters (stratum intercepts and other model effects not under test) are eliminated by conditioning on their sufficient statistics rather than relying on asymptotic approximations, which matters when case counts are small or sparse and standard Wald/likelihood-ratio inference is unreliable. Three algorithms are provided for different problem shapes: a fast closed-form method for a single two-level effect with strata as the only nuisance structure, following Guess, Lydick, Small and Miller (1987) doi:10.1093/oxfordjournals.aje.a114535 and Guess and Thomas (1990) doi:10.1097/00001648-199001000-00016 ; a multivariate shift algorithm for arbitrary categorical covariates and strata, generalizing Hirji, Mehta and Patel (1987) doi:10.2307/2289388 to bounded Poisson counts; and a network algorithm offering more aggressive mid-computation pruning for larger problems, generalizing Mehta, Patel and Senchaudhuri (1992) doi:10.1080/10618600.1992.10474574 to bounded Poisson counts.
